prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Production artwork for The Midnight Mill, Chapter 4. Make a precise 2x2 atlas of FOUR distinct 3:2 landscape paintings, overall 1536x1024 or larger same ratio. Equal quadrant boundaries at exact midpoints, edge-to-edge, NO gutters, frames or text. Each quadrant must be a complete camera composition.
REFERENCE 1 is Chapter 1: match its luminous detailed storybook gouache, fine soft fur, embroidered worn cloth, tactile mossy stone and timber, amber bakery light, wet copper leaves and plum-blue rainy night. REFERENCE 2 is established Poppy/Willow design, NOT the setting. Warm reassuring village refuge after danger, with subtle mystery.
CHARACTER LOCK: Poppy is a small cream rabbit with EXACTLY TWO EARS, ONE UPRIGHT AND ONE gently bent sideways, round youthful face, plum cape with subtle embroidered hem, rust knitted scarf, worn small brown satchel. Willow is a slightly taller grey-brown rabbit of the same young age, EXACTLY TWO long upright ears, youthful rounded face, moss-green coat with subtle checked lining, no bag. Do not make Willow an adult. Baker is the kindly adult brown hedgehog in reference 1, cream apron over burgundy sleeves, no hat. Ferryman is an adult brown OTTER, cream muzzle and whiskers, round ears, plain slate-blue raincoat, brown knit cap; NO badger stripes. His appearance must stay identical in every sheet.
SETTING LOCK: All panels take place outside the SAME weathered timber bakery beneath its deep russet canvas awning, amber glazed windows and open doorway behind, wet cobbles and plum-blue rain beyond. A flour sack rests on a low wooden crate for an improvised map surface. The map is folded/unreadable/angled away: no letters, distinct symbols, arrows, routes or evidence diagram. Any cup is a simple handleless earthenware cup of warm apple juice. Willow's paper lantern remains hidden and unlit beneath her coat. The small brass oil lamp has a glass chimney, NEVER a handle or cage.
NO text, signage, readable clock faces, speech bubbles, interface, labels, drawn collectible frogs, visible bell, Bram, mender, apprentice, supper bowls, ghost, floating bell, torn cloth, stitching evidence or actual journey away from the bakery. Do not depict anyone's hypothesis as fact. Keep key faces in the central-right portion of each cell, with quiet textured space left/lower for text overlays. Anatomically correct paws, two ears per rabbit, natural gestures.
SHEET 1, scene m16, Back beneath the awning.
TOP LEFT wide establishing shot: Poppy carrying the small oil lamp and Willow arrive at the still-bright bakery; baker holds door with her hip while two indistinct adult rodent neighbours carry one trestle table through the open door. Steam on upper windowpanes, covered tray inside. No ferryman yet.
TOP RIGHT medium: Poppy urgently tells baker what happened, free paw gesturing, lamp lowered in other paw; Willow beside her calmly intervenes. Worried attentive baker.
BOTTOM LEFT closer three-quarter group: baker guides both rabbits safely beneath the canvas awning, reassuring but purposeful; Poppy and Willow look shaken after rain, no map opened yet.
BOTTOM RIGHT wide tableau: villagers gather behind with coats and lanterns; ferryman arrives at edge of group with ONE ordinary hand saw safely lowered. Poppy spreads an unreadable map over a flour sack on a low crate, one cup of warm apple juice beside it. Small oil lamp rests safely on a separate adjacent ledge, Willow close beside Poppy.

SHEET 2, scene m17, Two accounts.
TOP LEFT medium: baker speaks seriously beneath awning, one floury paw gestures back towards rain, Poppy and Willow listen beside flour sack with obscured map. Ferryman nearby listening.
TOP RIGHT reverse medium: ferryman has just set ONE hand saw safely against bakery wall, describes what he heard, baker and rabbits listening; keep his slate-blue coat/brown knit cap consistent.
BOTTOM LEFT intimate reaction: Poppy looks from baker towards ferryman, troubled and uncertain, warm light catching fine wet fur and two correct ears; Willow attentive beside her. No imagination picture, bell or silhouette.
BOTTOM RIGHT broader three-quarter group: baker reflects on what she heard and looks outward towards dark square; ferryman calmly listening, Willow thoughtful, Poppy around her cup. Remain outside under awning, no literal flashback, no visible clock. Oil lamp resting on adjacent ledge throughout.

SHEET 3, scene m18, Time between the sounds.
TOP LEFT close three-quarter: Willow thoughtfully smooths a crease in the map on flour sack, Poppy beside her waiting anxiously; only blank reverse or indistinct folds visible, no map graphics.
TOP RIGHT reverse medium: Willow looks up to question ferryman, who recalls the earlier work; baker listens from doorway side, Poppy watches. All remain by same crate.
BOTTOM LEFT expressive two-shot: Poppy's worried face begins to relax as she understands Willow's explanation, Willow speaks carefully, ordinary villager silhouettes behind, no literal floating sounds or visual timeline.
BOTTOM RIGHT over shoulders: Willow leans over the unreadable map, Poppy leans closer; ferryman and baker see it from other side. The paper surface is foreshortened and partly obscured by paws, no readable clue or drawn roof. Cup and stationary oil lamp are on separate safe surfaces, exactly one of each.

SHEET 4, scene m19, The way round.
TOP LEFT close reaction: Poppy asks Willow a cautious question; Willow replies tentatively, not triumphant. Cream rabbit plum cape rust scarf brown satchel, grey-brown rabbit moss-green coat, all ears correct.
TOP RIGHT medium: ferryman bends over unreadable map on flour sack and speaks to the group; baker at his side listens, Poppy and Willow stand together.
BOTTOM LEFT wider angle under the awning: baker asks about reaching the shelter, ferryman gestures to explain a possible way round, ONE saw remains leaning against wall behind him; no literal bridge, route arrows, landscape inset or shelter illustration.
BOTTOM RIGHT medium close: Poppy describes the thorns she saw, gesturing with both paws while Willow watches attentively; ferryman listens. Keep the conversation at bakery, do NOT move characters into brambles. Rain and copper leaves outside.

additionalInstructionsForSheets2To5: REFERENCE 3 locks the bakery, baker and otter ferryman from the first Chapter 4 sheet. Preserve their design.
